steps.title: Two sticks, two jobs
steps.say: Arcade drive: one stick goes forward and back, the other turns. Most drivers prefer it.

marks.label: left and right: no minus sign

steps.title: The math
steps.say: To turn right, the left side goes faster than the right. Adding and subtracting `turn` does exactly that.

steps.title: Try some numbers
steps.say: Work these out in your head before you drive.

board.code:
forward 0.5, turn 0.0  ->  left 0.5,  right 0.5   (straight)
forward 0.0, turn 0.5  ->  left 0.5,  right -0.5  (spin right)
forward 0.5, turn 0.5  ->  left 1.0,  right 0.0   (curve right)

steps.title: Duty cycle
steps.say: A **duty cycle** is how much battery voltage the motor gets, from -1.0 (full reverse) to 1.0 (full forward). Bigger numbers get clipped to 1.0.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Drive it
steps.say: **W / S** drive forward and back, **Arrow Left / Right** turn. If it turns the wrong way, check the sign on `turn`.
